crime_highlights: But Kale Gabriel had his loaded gun stuck inside the waistband of his pants
Kale Gabriel initiated the physical fight with Ryan White by kicking him in the head
Kale Gabriel intentionally shot Ryan White, causing his death
rationale_highlights: There are ways in which he is a product of the residential school system
Kale Gabriel was a drug dealer with a gun but he didn’t become that by a single act of free will
But they are also a product of his background and his environment

His decision to remain in Mulgrave Park, to get a gun rather than to call the police and to seek out the confrontation with Ryan White make no sense at all unless they are considered in light of his background
note: Court says context explains but does not justify or lower culpability.
